description: Header file defining the DecodedAudio class for representing decoded audio frames in a media player, including methods for accessing audio data, adjusting for seek/discard, and format switching.

classes.name: DecodedAudio
classes.description: Represents a decoded audio frame with methods for data access, format conversion, and adjustments for seeking and discarding.

methods.name: channels
methods.description: Returns the number of audio channels.

methods.name: sample_type
methods.description: Returns the sample type of the audio data.

methods.name: storage_type
methods.description: Returns the storage type of the audio data.

methods.name: is_end_of_stream
methods.description: Indicates if this is an end-of-stream marker.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the first audio frame.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the audio data.

methods.name: data_as_int16
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the audio data as int16_t array.

methods.name: data_as_float32
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the audio data as float array.

methods.name: size_in_bytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the audio data in bytes.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns the number of audio frames.

methods.name: ShrinkTo
methods.description: Reduces the data size to the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: AdjustForSeekTime
methods.description: Adjusts the audio data for a seek operation to a specific time.

methods.name: AdjustForDiscardedDurations
methods.description: Adjusts the audio data after discarding durations from front and back.

methods.name: IsFormat
methods.description: Checks if the audio data matches specified format.

methods.name: SwitchFormatTo
methods.description: Returns a new DecodedAudio with a different format.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the DecodedAudio object.
